title: Towards Resilience: Slice-Driven Orchestration of Mobile IoMT in 6G-Edge-Continuum
abstract: arXiv:2610.17296v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Emerging healthcare services, such as real-time diagnostics, remote health monitoring and computer-assisted surgery, require stringent Quality of Service (QoS) guarantees while operating under limited and heterogeneous edge resources. Existing Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) orchestration methods primarily focus on communication metrics such as latency and bandwidth, while overlooking edge resource constraints and dynamic adaptation to workload and user mobility. This paper presents a novel resource-slicing-based adaptive orchestration framework that integrates 5G network slicing (NS), resource-aware orchestration, and mobility-aware task offloading into a single adaptive system. IoMT services are assigned to distinct 5G network slices while jointly considering CPU capacity, memory availability and amount of storage, enabling more efficient service placement and execution. translated_title: 迈向韧性：6G-边缘连续体中移动医疗物联网的分片驱动编排
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.17296v1 公告类型：新 摘要：新兴医疗服务，如实时诊断、远程健康监测和计算机辅助手术，需要在有限的异构边缘资源下运行的同时保证严格的服务质量（QoS）。现有的医疗物联网编排方法主要关注延迟和带宽等通信指标，而忽视了边缘资源约束以及针对工作负载和用户移动性的动态适应。本文提出了一种新颖的基于资源切片的自适应编排框架，将5G网络切片（NS）、资源感知编排和移动性感知任务卸载集成到一个单一的自适应系统中。IoMT服务被分配到不同的5G网络切片中，同时综合考虑CPU容量、内存可用性和存储空间，从而实现更高效的服务放置和执行。此外，该系统支持用户移动性和动态任务……
tldr: 本文提出了一种将5G网络切片、资源感知编排与移动性感知任务卸载融合为单一自适应系统的框架，通过综合考量CPU、内存和存储等边缘资源约束，实现了6G-边缘连续体中移动医疗物联网服务的高效放置与韧性保障。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel resource-slicing-based adaptive orchestration framework that integrates 5G network slicing, resource-aware orchestration, and mobility-aware task offloading into a single adaptive system, enabling efficient and resilient placement of mobile IoMT services in the 6G-edge-continuum.
